expected_outcomes: Finds the missing owner check (IDOR / broken object-level authorization): handleFlowGet returns any flow by id to any authenticated user without comparing f.OwnerID to the session user
Locates it in handleFlowGet, not in handleFlowList or handleFlowDelete
Rates it high or medium-high (cross-user data disclosure)
Recommends the same owner comparison used in handleFlowDelete and returning 404 (not 403) on mismatch to avoid id enumeration
Does not flag handleFlowList or handleFlowDelete as vulnerable, both are correctly owner-scoped
